Anti-slip bowl for long-eared dogs Dogs with floppy ears are often used as sniffer dogs - with their long ears they whirl up particles lying on the ground and sniff out tracks. But in other situations, the ears of Bassets and Cocker Spaniels can also be annoying. If the dog's ears are so long that they hang in the food or water bowl when eating or drinking, a suitable dog bowl is needed. The feeding bowl for long-eared dogs is narrow and has a high rim. This allows the animal to eat and drink comfortably. The dog ears stay clean and food or water is not contaminated. The stainless steel floppy-ear dog food bowl is dishwasher suitable and non-slip thanks to its rubber ring.
